{{Quote|I'm taking charge.|Denal|<ref name="TCWMobile">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (mobile)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' mobile game]]</ref>&mdash;576 [[Troop/Legends|troops]]<ref name="Guide">{{InsiderCite|84|Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic}}</ref>}}
'''Denal''' was the name of a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] in the elite [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]]. Considered one of the most experienced members of that unit, he survived many [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] campaigns alongside [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] and [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. At the start of the war, Denal accompanied Rex, Skywalker, and Skywalker's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], on a [[Raid on Skytop Station/Legends|mission]] to destroy [[Skytop Station/Legends|Skytop Station]], a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]] located on [[Ruusan 2/Legends|one]] of the three [[Three Sisters|moons]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]]. The group successfully completed their mission, blowing up the station with several explosive charges. Of the five-man squad of [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] that was sent there along with the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], only Denal and Rex survived the mission. Denal also saw action on [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and [[Orto Plutonia/Legends|Orto Plutonia]], conducting many missions on those planets. He [[Mission to Rodia (Denal)|rescued]] a [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] of clone troopers from a Separatist ambush, [[Mission to Orto Plutonia|recovered]] a lost [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] cargo, and helped a [[Unidentified Jedi (Orto Plutonia)|Jedi]] in distress defeat a force of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. On one occasion, he even [[Second mission to Tatooine|saved]] Tano from a Separatist [[Separatist Tatooine prison|prison]] on Tatooine.

Denal was also involved in the [[Mission to Tatooine (Denal)|discovery]] and [[Third mission to Orto Plutonia|destruction]] of a new Confederate [[Radar-cloaking superweapon|superweapon]]&mdash;one that could prevent Republic radar from detecting enemy [[Army/Legends|armies]]. Under the command of Skywalker, Denal participated in a Republic [[Battle of Devaron/Legends|attack]] on the forces of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] above the planet Devaron. The Republic hoped to rescue the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bolla Ropal/Legends|Bolla Ropal]] from Bane and retrieve two valuable items stolen by the bounty hunter&mdash;a Jedi [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] and the [[Kyber memory crystal/Legends|Kyber memory crystal]], which contained information on every [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Youngling/Legends|child]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Denal was one of the clones who infiltrated Bane's [[Cad Bane's Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]], which slowly began to tear itself apart, having been set on the self-destruct mode by Bane. The Republic did not manage to rescue Master Ropal, whom Cad Bane had [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] to [[Death/Legends|death]]. Aboard the [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|frigate]], Denal confronted the bounty hunter himself, but was killed by him. Bane donned Denal's [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|armor]] in order to disguise himself as the clone trooper. Still in possession of the holocron and the Kyber crystal, the bounty hunter escaped from the crumbling starship with the Republic troops.

==Biography==
===Clone Wars===
A [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]],<ref name="Databank" /> the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who took the name Denal<ref name="TCWCE" /> was born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to serve in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="Databank" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Denal was a member of the famed [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]].<ref name="TCWDotD" /> He was one of the most experienced [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] in the 501st, having served on the planet [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] alongside [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]]<ref name="DotD decoded">{{TCW|Duel of the Droids|d=y}}</ref> and later surviving many campaigns beside him and the [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].<ref name="CWT">{{PocketModel|set=Clone Wars Tactics|cardname=Denal}}</ref> Denal's service was such that Rex came to rely on him and his expertise on a number of missions against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="TCWCE" /> Denal was assigned to patrol the feared [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region, a lawless and dangerous region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that put his skills to the test.<ref name="Bobblehead">{{WebCite|url=https://www.ebay.com/itm/144957856287|text=Funko Bobblehead card backing|work=[[Wikipedia:eBay|eBay]]|archivedate=20230910115513}} {{C|{{WebCite|url=https://i.ebayimg.com/images/g/M58AAOSw8TNj9p26/s-l500.png|text=Direct image link|work=[[Wikipedia:eBay|eBay]]|archivedate=20230910115818}}}}</ref> 

===Mission to Skytop Station===
{{Quote|I could always hot-wire it, sir.|Denal, after R3-S6 fails to open the door|audio=HotwireIt-DotD.flac|<ref name="TCWDotD" />}}
[[File:Rex_Denal_Ahsoka.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Denal, Ahsoka Tano and Rex ready to face General Grievous.]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Duel of the Droids Date">{{TCWdates|107}}</ref> under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Rex, Denal participated in a [[Raid on Skytop Station/Legends|mission]] to neutralize the [[Skytop Station/Legends|Skytop Station]], a Separatist [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]] floating in the sky of the [[Ruusan 2/Legends|Ruusan moon]]. The secondary objective was to rescue Anakin Skywalker's [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], who had fallen into the possession of the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] [[Gha Nachkt/Legends|Gha Nachkt]] and was later transported to the Skytop Station. There, Nachkt hoped to sell the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] to the Separatist [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].<ref name="TCWDotD" />

Infiltrating the station with [[JT-12 jetpack/Legends|JT-12 jetpacks]],<ref name="DotD decoded" /> Denal, Rex, Skywalker's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], astromech droid [[R3-S6/Legends|R3-S6]], and three clones soon separated from Skywalker, who ordered them to plant charges while he went in search of R2-D2. Denal and the others soon reached a door that was [[Ray shield/Legends|ray-shielded]]. Tano instructed R3-S6 to disable the shield, but the droid, who was in fact a Separatist [[Spy/Legends|spy]], instead stalled them until [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] arrived. Denal was first to hear them coming and warned his teammates. He suggested hot-wiring the door, but R3's seeming ineptitude blocked it.<ref name="TCWDotD" />

The group was outnumbered, yet were able to use [[Electromagnetic pulse grenade/Legends|EMP grenades]] to disable the battle droids. At this point, Grievous arrived and engaged them, quickly knocking [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Tano unconscious. Grievous then [[Death/Legends|killed]] three clones and stunned Rex and Denal. As the droid general was about to finish off the two clones, Tano recovered in time to block the attack. She then ran off, drawing Grievous after her and allowing Rex and Denal to set charges on the [[Repulsorlift generator/Legends|repulsorlift generator]] for the station. Later, in the landing [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]], the clones met with Skywalker, who managed to rescue R2 and call his [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']]. When they informed Skywalker of Ahsoka's actions, he ordered them to accompany him to assist his Padawan. But as they set off on a rescue, R3 appeared and sealed the hangar, revealing itself to them as a Separatist spy by activating several [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]]. A moment later, several [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]] arrived. Rex, Denal, Skywalker and the ''Twilight''{{'s}} [[Unidentified clone trooper pilot (Twilight)/Legends|pilot]] hid behind several shipping crates and fired at the droids. Skywalker then ordered Rex to trigger the explosives just as Tano rejoined the group. Together, they destroyed all enemies, and with the help of R2, who opened hangar doors and destroyed R3, they escaped the doomed [[Battlesphere/Legends|battlesphere]] aboard the ''Twilight''.<ref name="TCWDotD" />

===Superweapon===
{{Quote|This is where the fun begins.|Denal|<ref name="TCWMobile" />}}
[[File:CellphoneDenal.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Denal on Rodia]]
At one point during the war, rumors about a new Confederacy secret project in development somewhere in the Outer Rim led the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to send entire [[Legion/Legends|legions]] of clone troopers to the region in order to investigate. As part of a [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] of clones<ref name="TCWMobile" />&mdash;Denal was dispatched to the planet [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]]. While on Rodia, his battalion was [[Mission to Rodia (Denal)|ambushed]] and surrounded by overwhelming droid forces, after enemy [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] took out most of the Republic [[Transport/Legends|transports]]. Denal took charge of the battalion and ordered his men to call for reinforcements. However, they soon discovered that the droids had been jamming their signals, so Denal and his men sought to capture a [[Comm unit/Legends|comm]] [[Separatist comm relay station|relay station]] in order to contact the fleet. After successfully capturing it and defending against droid counter-attacks, Denal and his battalion managed to contact the fleet and escape to safety on a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunship]].<ref name="TCWMobile" />

Soon, Denal was contacted by Captain Rex, who ordered him to make way for reinforcements by destroying all droids in a nearby jungle clearing. Denal quickly completed his objective, allowing the Republic to land additional forces on Rodia. He was then once again contacted by Rex with the order to destroy a [[Separatist transport factory|transport factory]]. The factory could only be destroyed by hacking the console that triggered the [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destruct mechanism]]. Instead of using the shortest way to the console, Denal chose to go through the hidden path in the swamp, destroying an [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|MTT]] with a [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]] along the way. He then triggered the base's self-destruction mechanism and left with his squad on a LAAT/i. Following the completion of that mission, Denal was called to assist a lone [[Unidentified Jedi (Orto Plutonia)|Jedi]] in distress on the frozen world of [[Orto Plutonia/Legends|Orto Plutonia]]. His squad [[Mission to Orto Plutonia|helped]] the Jedi to defeat the droids and then evacuated him from the planet. Near the evacuation LAAT/i, they met Tano, who was sent by her Master to help the Jedi. Denal then participated in two subsequent missions on Orto Plutonia, involving the recovery of a lost Republic weapons shipment and the search for a missing LAAT/i and its crew. During these missions Denal grew suspicious of a large Separatist presence on Orto Plutonia and of droids that could somehow evade being detected by Republic radar.<ref name="TCWMobile" />

[[File:Denal2.png|thumb|left|250px|Denal firing his DC-15S]]
Denal's squad was next [[Mission to Tatooine (Denal)|dispatched]] by Rex to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], to investigate a seemingly deserted [[Separatist Tatooine base|Separatist base]], which was in fact swarming with droids. After clearing the base of the hostiles, Denal grew suspicious, as he was informed by the scout team about the droid presence in the [[Desert/Legends|desert]]. After completing yet another mission there, Denal was told by Rex that the Republic had discovered another base deep in the desert, a hidden Confederacy [[Separatist Tatooine research station|research station]], that was suspected to be related to the rumored new Confederacy project. Since the station was already in the process of evacuation, Denal was ordered to act quickly, before the enemy could destroy all evidence of the project. His suspicions finally proved true, Denal led his clones into the station, only to find a message from General Grievous, who claimed that the Republic would soon be finished, and to be attacked by a complement of droids, including a [[DSD1 dwarf spider droid/Legends|DSD1 dwarf spider droid]].<ref name="TCWMobile" />

After downloading secret plans hidden inside the station, Denal and his men escaped the installation by calling a gunship with the enemy console, but not before disarming a bomb planted on it. The data retrieved from Tatooine revealed a new Separatist [[Radar-cloaking superweapon|superweapon]], capable of clouding entire [[Army/Legends|armies]] from Republic radar. Denal was sent to [[Second mission to Rodia (Denal)|investigate further]] on Rodia. He infiltrated the local [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Trade Federation Rodia base|base]] and stole another set of data. [[Second mission to Tatooine|Returning to Tatooine]] to investigate a small droid encampment, Denal received intelligence from [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] about Tano being held in a Separatist [[Separatist Tatooine prison|prison]]. Once inside, Denal's troops again encountered the same Jedi they had rescued earlier on Orto Plutonia. The Jedi joined them in a quest to free Skywalker's Padawan. With his help, Denal was able to rescue Tano.<ref name="TCWMobile" />

It was then decided to steal the superweapon plans and attack the main Separatist headquarters. Denal was ordered by Rex to destroy several Confederacy bases that supplied the main base in order to weaken its defenses. Once again reuniting with the Jedi on Tatooine, Denal destroyed a [[Separatist construction yard|construction yard]] that produced droid [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]], then [[Second mission to Orto Plutonia|infiltrated]] the [[Orto Plutonia research station|research station]] on Orto Plutonia and stole the superweapon [[Radar-cloaking superweapon plans|plans]]. Later, he [[Third mission to Rodia|destroyed]] a [[Separatist weapons factory|weapons factory]] on Rodia. Dropped behind enemy lines, Denal then [[Third mission to Orto Plutonia|reached]] the main Separatist [[Orto Plutonia base|base]] on Orto Plutonia, where the superweapon was being developed. After receiving some help from Tano, who cut a way through the ice with her lightsaber, Denal infiltrated the base and created a massive short-circuit in the superweapon's mainframe. A chain reaction began, bringing an end to the construction of the weapon. After he returned to the fleet, Denal was congratulated by General Kenobi, only to be sent by Rex to another mission soon thereafter.<ref name="TCWMobile" />

===Devaron===
{{Quote|Hold it right there! You're not going anywhere, bounty hunter.|Denal, to Cad Bane|<ref name="CoD">{{TCW|Cargo of Doom}}</ref>}}
Later in the war, Denal was among the Republic troops that participated in a [[Battle of Devaron/Legends|battle]] above the planet [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]]. The Republic task force under the command of Anakin Skywalker traveled to the planet to confront the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] bounty hunter [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]]&mdash;who had recently stolen a Jedi [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] from the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the galactic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="HH">{{TCW|Holocron Heist}}</ref>&mdash;and had also abducted [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bolla Ropal/Legends|Bolla Ropal]] on Devaron. Bane hoped to force Ropal to open the holocron so he could read the data stored in the [[Kyber memory crystal/Legends|Kyber memory crystal]]&mdash;a repository of every known [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Youngling/Legends|child]] in the galaxy. In an attempt to prevent Bane from accessing this vital information and delivering it to the Separatists, the Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] [[Space warfare/Legends|attacked]] [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]] under Bane's command. After the Republic destroyed the engines of the [[Cad Bane's Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|frigate]] that was carrying Ropal and Bane, Skywalker decided to board it and recover the holocron and the [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]], as well as rescue the captive Jedi Master.<ref name="CoD" />

[[File:Resolute_briefing_CoD.png|thumb|right|250px|Skywalker informs Denal and Rex of his plan to infiltrate Cad Bane's frigate.]]
The Republic [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]], however, were not equipped with any kind of boarding craft, so the Jedi planned to use the pressure-sealed and magnetic feet-equipped [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] in the assault on the enemy ship. Along with Skywalker, Ahsoka Tano, R2-D2, Captain Rex and three [[Brigade/Legends|brigades]] of clone troopers, Denal boarded one of the walkers, which were then dropped onto the dorsal hull of Bane's [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]]. After a brief battle on the hull, the Republic forces infiltrated the frigate itself, though their relatively easy victory was due to the fact that Cad Bane did not send reinforcements, wanting to lure Skywalker and Tano inside the ship and force them to open the holocron; Ropal had refused to do so and had been [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] to death by the bounty hunter.<ref name="CoD" />

The Jedi, Rex, Denal and the other clones quickly reached and secured the ship's [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]], although Bane had already fled to the other part of the vessel. Skywalker then ordered Rex to destroy all [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] so that Bane could not escape with the holocron. At this moment, explosions started to tear the ship apart; Bane had initiated the self-destruct sequence. Although [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] told the Republic troops to leave the doomed vessel, Skywalker refused and the strike team continued their mission, eventually finding Master Ropal's dead body, which was transferred to Skywalker's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']]. Moving further into the frigate, Skywalker, Tano, Denal and the clones spotted Bane running through one of the corridors and followed the bounty hunter to the gunnery deck, only to be confronted by a force of B1 and B2 battle droids.<ref name="CoD" />

As a firefight ensued, Bane used his wrist gauntlet controls to deactivate the ship's artificial [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]], making the Jedi and the clones lift into the air. Noting that the clones had been trained for such situations, Denal advised them to activate the magnetic gripsoles on their [[Boot/Legends|boots]]. R2-D2, however, soon reactivated the gravity and Bane fled with the holocron with Tano pursuing him. Skywalker tried to follow the two and assist his Padawan, but was stopped by a [[Blast door/Legends|blast door]]. As he started cutting through it with his lightsaber, one of the battle droids accidentally fired at an ammunition shell, triggering an explosion, as a result of which, debris fell, separating Denal and the clone troopers from Skywalker. Nevertheless, the Jedi set off to find his Padawan and ordered the clones to reach the hangar bay, find a ship which could be used to escape and wait for him and Tano.<ref name="CoD" />

[[File:DenalBane2-CoD.png|thumb|left|250px|Denal and Koho corner Cad Bane.]]
The troopers complied and reached the hangar, where they found a Separatist [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttle]] guarded by a detachment of battle droids. As Denal and the other troopers engaged in a battle with the droids, the explosions throughout the frigate intensified, and Admiral Yularen told the clones to hurry with their escape. Rex then dispatched Denal and fellow trooper [[Koho/Legends|Koho]] to find General Skywalker. The first person whom Denal and Koho found at an upper level of the hangar was Bane himself, who had managed to evade the two Jedi. Denal ordered the Duros not to move, telling him that he would not get away.<ref name="CoD" /> Denal, however, was not able to subdue the Bane and both he and Koho were killed by the bounty hunter. Bane then disguised himself as Denal by putting on his [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|armor]].<ref name="CotF Ep Guide" />

As Skywalker and Tano reached the shuttle and were boarding it together with the clone troopers, Bane faked his own death; he made it appear to the Republic troops as if Denal and Bane struggled at the upper level of the hangar, and Bane was killed by the trooper, his body falling on the floor of the lower level. After witnessing this, the shuttle picked up the disguised Bane, still in possession of the holocron and the Kyber crystal. Thinking him to be Denal, Skywalker asked the survivor if he was able to recover the holocron, and Bane answered that he could not. Because the frigate was about to destroy itself, the Jedi did not return to pick up the holocron from "Bane's" body, and the shuttle departed the frigate, right before it exploded.<ref name="CoD" /> Alongside the Republic forces, Cad Bane returned to the ''Resolute'', where his deception was discovered by Tano. Nevertheless, Bane managed to steal a [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighter]] and escaped by making a jump to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="CotF">{{TCW|Children of the Force}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Why would there be any Confederacy battle droids in the desert?''"<br />"''We do not know. Probably just some recon squad or lost unit.''"<br />"''Somehow I feel that hard to believe, sir. There's something strange going on here&hellip;''"<br />"''Cut the chatter.''"<br />"''Yes, sir. We will check it out, sir.|Denal and Captain Rex|<ref name="TCWMobile" />}}
Like his genetic template, Jango Fett, Denal was 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]], or 6 [[Foot/Legends|feet]] tall.<ref name="TCWCE" /> He had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], black [[Hair/Legends|hair]],<ref name="Action Figure" /> and tan skin.<ref name="Skin" /> Denal was an experienced trooper and a gifted leader, as indicated by the many successful missions his squad completed. He was very by-the-book, and as such, he usually did not question any orders from those of superior rank.<ref name="TCWMobile" /> A veteran of the war, Denal served alongside Captain Rex numerous times, and his proficiency was such that the Clone Captain came to both rely on him and trust his experience and instincts in their shared missions.<ref name="TCWCE" />

Denal considered the battle droids' appearance in the Tatooine desert to be strange, and he grew suspicious of the droids constantly evading detection by Republic radars.<ref name="TCWMobile" /> After the gravity aboard Bane's frigate was deactivated, Denal was quick to figure out to use magnetic boots and advised the other clones to do the same. Denal was bold enough to confront and attempt to subdue Cad Bane,<ref name="CoD" /> who was considered to be one of the deadliest bounty hunters at the time.<ref name="SWArchive-The Chilling Season Finale Introduces a Deadly New Enemy">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20090317.html|text=The Chilling Season Finale Introduces a Deadly New Enemy}}</ref>

==Skills and abilities==
Denal was skilled in combat, recon, and military tactics, and he additionally had some expertise in [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpacks]].<ref name="TCWCE" /> He was known for being able to "hot-wire" a control panel<ref name="TCWDotD" /> and found himself forced to improvise after R3-S6's deliberate attempts to stall the Republic strike team.<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1]]''</ref> However, despite his expertise, Denal was not skilled enough to defeat Bane, and he was ultimately killed by the bounty hunter, though the bounty hunter was left [[Blood/Legends|bleeding]] after their confrontation.<ref name="CotF Ep Guide" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|Magnetics! You were trained for this!|Denal|<ref name="CoD" />}}
[[File:DenalCable-CoD.png|thumb|left|250px|Denal using the magnetic cable]]
Denal wore a custom helmet marked with the blue color scheme of the 501st Legion.<ref name="TCWCE" /> During the mission to Skytop Station and the battle above Devaron, he utilized a [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]]. During the latter mission, Denal also made use of night vision goggles and a magnetic cable built into his blaster,<ref name="CoD" /> while showing proficiency with a jetpack during the infiltration of Skytop Station.<ref name="TCWDotD" /> His own jetpack featured a built-in [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launcher]].<ref name="Action Figure" /> He also used a [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifle]] in combat.<ref name="TCWCE" /> Throughout his service, Denal frequently used explosive<ref name="TCWMobile" /> and EMP grenades.<ref name="TCWDotD" /><ref name="TCWMobile" />

==Behind the scenes==
Denal was created for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' project. He appeared in the seventh episode of the series' [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]], and the second episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]], titled "[[Duel of the Droids]]" and "[[Cargo of Doom]]," respectively, but ultimately was confirmed to be killed off in "[[Children of the Force]]." Like all clones in the show, Denal was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]].<ref name="DotD Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode007.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Duel of the Droids}}</ref> He later appeared as a main character in the wireless telephone game [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (mobile)|''The Clone Wars'']]. While most of the missions shown in the game can be completed in different order than presented here, this article represents the best possible way of completing them, which allows the player to use all mission bonuses, such as reinforcement points and air strikes.<ref name="TCWMobile" /> Denal later appeared as a playable character in the [[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]] version of the [[2009]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]''.<ref name="Republic Heroes">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]'' {{C|[[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]] edition}}</ref>

===Inconsistencies===
A picture of Denal was incorrectly captioned as "Clone Commander Rex" in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Activity Annual: Summer Edition 2009]]''.<ref name="Activity Annual">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Activity Annual: Summer Edition 2009]]''</ref>

Throughout the mobile game, instead of his own trademark armor seen in "Duel of the Droids," Denal wears what seems to be the standard blue-colored lieutenant variant of the Phase I armor.<ref name="TCWMobile" /> In "Duel of the Droids," the markings on Denal's armor tend to disappear from time to time, most notably in a scene after one of the droids gets his head torn off.<ref name="TCWDotD" /> The online episode guide for "Cargo of Doom" mistakenly claims that Denal appears in the episode "[[Downfall of a Droid]]" instead of "Duel of the Droids," though the latter episode is still linked in the guide.<ref name="Cargo of Doom guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode202.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Cargo of Doom}}</ref>

There is a notable discrepancy between the mobile game and the television series regarding Denal's rank. During the game, Denal receives several promotions for his performance on the battlefield, eventually becoming a [[Clone Commander/Legends|commander]]. This, however, conflicts with "Cargo of Doom," where Denal takes orders from Captain Rex, even though commanders out-rank captains in the Galactic Republic Army.<ref name="Guide" /> In fact, Denal continues to take orders from Captain Rex after his promotion to commander in the mobile game itself. Because of such conflict between the game and the series, Denal's rank is not established in this article, although his promotions&mdash;or at least some of them&mdash;may still be official.<ref name="TCWMobile" />

[[File:RexDenalRHDS.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Denal and Rex on Skytop Station in the ''Republic Heroes'' Nintendo DS version]]
Additionally, there is a conflict between "Duel of the Droids" and ''Republic Heroes'' regarding the portrayal of the mission to Skytop Station. In the game, the Republic strike team splits up into two groups at the beginning of the mission and approaches Skytop Station's main reactor from two separate paths. Skywalker deliberately takes the wrong direction and goes to search for R2-D2 along with Tano, leaving Denal and Rex to destroy the reactor. Soon, the Jedi find themselves in [[Sector AA-23]], where all systems are suddenly shut down. Skywalker contacts Rex and Denal, requesting assistance. On their way to the reactor, the troopers find a control panel and reactivate all systems, allowing the Jedi to continue their way and free R2. Denal and Rex then destroy the reactor and set off to rendezvous with the Jedi at the hangar.<ref name="Republic Heroes" />

The destruction of the reactor, however, triggers a failsafe lockdown of the hangar's doors, which can only be deactivated via two computer terminals. Tano and R2-D2 head to the hangar to deactivate the terminal located outside of it, while Skywalker moves through the station to the second one. Denal and Rex reach the hangar first, fight off several battle droids and prepare the ''Twilight'' for takeoff. Tano and R2 soon arrive there as well, and the astromech successfully deactivates the first terminal. Several [[IG-86 sentinel droid/Legends|IG-86 sentinel droids]] then pin down Tano, R2, Rex and Denal inside the ''Twilight''. Skywalker, however, manages to deactivate the second terminal, returns to the hangar and defeats the IG-86s. Denal, Rex and the Jedi then escape from the station.<ref name="Republic Heroes" />
